title: Support scoped schema overlays for pinned source readers
body: The local GPU schema needed Undertow KindSchemas.RuntimeStateFormats, so the single-root --schema-json-source command forced staging core/src together with VIXEN sources. The pinned reader then rejected the newer named visibility argument in FactionAiKinds.cs, so generation had to exclude that unrelated directory. Add multi-root resolution or a filtered schema-source option that preserves pinned compatibility without dropping unrelated declarations.

title: Launch dotnet run output from artifacts-path
body: The queued command dotnet run --project <pinned CodegenTool.csproj> -c Release --artifacts-path build/wsl/codegen/tool-artifacts -nodeReuse:false built under the artifacts tree, then attempted to launch the absent project-local bin/Release/net8.0/CodegenTool apphost (Win32Exception 2). We could continue only by invoking the CMake-published CodegenTool.dll. Make dotnet run launch from its configured artifacts path or document an isolated invocation.

title: Expose source-resolvable GLSL math intrinsics
body: The pinned GLSL visitor maps math.max, math.pow, math.clamp, and math.select by name, but the source loader has no resolvable math intrinsic surface. The VIXEN source needed local throwing stubs solely to make those shader-only calls resolvable. Add a declarative shader intrinsic surface that does not require a consumer-local runtime-looking shim.

title: Derive GPU dispatch extents from texture facets
body: The texture schema marks both images as presentation-derived, but the GPU emitter exposes _ExtentX and _ExtentY as push fields without a renderer provider. BuildRenderGraph had to map them by hand to RenderTargetNode WIDTH_OUT and HEIGHT_OUT. Derive those extent providers from the schema-owned texture facets and graph output.

title: Default the SDI merger to the manifest shader root
body: The new SDI manifest entry references shaders that include Generated/LightingConfig.glsl. The documented sdi_tool merge-variants shaders/sdi-variants.json command failed to resolve that include until I added . to the manifest includePaths list. Infer the shader root or make the include root contract explicit so adding a program does not require this manual path discovery.

title: Lower singleton SSBO inputs into legal GLSL body parameters
body: VIXEN singleton inputs backed by storage-buffer arrays generate GLSL body parameters such as in float meter[] and in LightingConfig LightingConfigSSBO[], which the shader compiler rejects with array size required. Declaring LightingConfig as a scalar routes it through Gaia component validation and fails YK_KF_4022 because the GPU struct is not a Gaia schema kind. Add a declarative lowering that reads singleton SSBO rows at element zero while keeping generated body parameters legal, without a duplicate Gaia kind or hand-edited shader.

title: Make native kernel snapshots work with WSL-owned sources
body: Windows CMake could not use the assigned WSL kernel worktree through its UNC path: Git rejected the repository as dubious ownership. Setting GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 for that process then broke FetchContent clones with fatal: bogus count in GIT_CONFIG_COUNT. I recovered by bundling a99311ce into the native checkout, creating a detached local kernel snapshot, and configuring with that root plus an in-worktree kernel cache. Make the snapshot helper support the WSL-owned source without manual bundle provisioning or process-wide Git config side effects.

title: Make native multi-label CTest filters select label unions
body: On the native Windows CTest inventory, ctest --test-dir build/native --show-only=json-v1 -L "RenderGraph|SVO|Application" returned zero selected tests, while the unfiltered inventory contained 8 RenderGraph, 0 SVO, and 44 Application tests and -L Application selected 44. Make the split runner select label unions portably across native Windows and WSL, or run its labels as separate selections.

title: Make CodeGraph indexes available in VIXEN lane worktrees
body: The required first query, codegraph explore "VIXEN exposure tone map GPU system render graph SDI parity", failed because this worktree had no .codegraph index. I had to continue with rg and file reads. Provision or resolve a shared repo-aware index when a lane worktree is created so CodeGraph-first exploration remains available.

title: Couple shared shader-schema outputs to kernel override regeneration
body: The queued full build (cmake --build build/wsl --parallel 4) failed at lightingconfig_check because LightingConfig.glsl was stale under kernel 928c40c9: the new generator emits the nested Light definition under its own guard. I recovered by manually discovering and running cmake --build build/wsl --target lightingconfig_regen. Couple shared generated outputs to the selected kernel generator snapshot or expose a single regeneration target that refreshes every affected output.

title: Prevent trailing whitespace in native FetchContent cache paths
body: Queued native configure exited 1 because cmd.exe assignment of VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE followed by && cmake retained a trailing space in the value. CMake then tried to write C:/vixen-native/rjs2/.tmp/fetch /glm-subbuild/CMakeLists.txt.tmp and failed. Recovery used a whitespace-free command separator with no space before &&; a native build helper should construct and validate this cache path without trailing whitespace.

title: Stage native TBB runtime for GoogleTest discovery
body: A queued native full build failed during gtest_discover_tests for test_resource_management.exe with exit 0xc0000135 because tbb12.dll was absent from discovery PATH. dumpbin found it under build/native/msvc_19.44_cxx_64_md_release. Adding that directory to PATH let CMake register tests; provide this runtime path centrally to discovery.

title: Preserve VS toolchain PATH in native build launchers
body: The first native PATH retry set PATH=...;%PATH% in a cmd.exe /c string that also calls VsDevCmd.bat; cmd expanded %PATH% before VsDevCmd and CMake was not found. A delayed-expansion invocation with /v:on and !PATH! worked. The native build helper should establish the toolchain environment before adding runtime paths.

title: Normalize generated code line endings for native drift checks
body: The full native build failed recipe_simd_check for RecipeSimd.g.hpp and RecipeGlslLiterals.g.h while the WSL check passed. recipe_simd_regen reported zero added or removed lines, but changed the native working files from CRLF and then the native all-target check passed. Normalize line endings in the check or make generated output stable for Windows checkouts.

title: Share the WSL Vulkan SDK cache with baseline source snapshots
body: Configuring the same-base source archive with Vulkan auto-provision enabled downloaded and extracted another 320 MB Vulkan SDK under build/rjs2-baseline-source/VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk even though the active worktree already has VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk/1.4.350.1. Let isolated source snapshots point to the shared SDK cache so baseline validation does not repeat provider provisioning.

title: Share X11 development cache with baseline source snapshots
body: Configuring the extracted 2685b1e9 baseline source tree auto-provisioned another X11 development package set under build/rjs2-baseline-source/VIXEN/.windowing-deps because the repo-local provider cache was absent from the source archive. Reuse the active VIXEN windowing cache for isolated source snapshots to avoid repeated system dependency provisioning.

title: Route native CMake build-tree commands through Windows paths
body: A native CMake target-help invocation from WSL at /mnt/c/vixen-native/rjs2/build/native failed because the cache was created as C:/vixen-native/rjs2/build/native; CMake rejected the path mismatch. I had to inspect VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt for the regen target. Provide a queued native target-list or build entry point that uses the required Windows drive path.

title: Distinguish native correctness captures from GPU benchmarks
body: The required native correctness command `--resource gpu` launching `cmd.exe` and CTest was classified as gpu=exclusive because the queue detects `.exe` in the command. These per-state capture jobs then waited behind shared GPU work and blocked new shared starts. Let explicit correctness intent override Windows executable detection; reserve device exclusivity for `--gpu-benchmark` or benchmark labels.

title: Explain wrapper signals during chained native capture jobs
body: A queued native look-dev A/B job completed the reference CTest and started the system CTest, then the wrapper ended with `exit=76 state=WRAPPER_SIGNALED payload_exit=143` and no payload diagnostic. The first four captures were preserved but the A/B pair was incomplete, requiring a fresh GPU queue job. Preserve the child process group or record the supervisor signal source so a native capture job is not discarded without a cause.

title: Derive state-frame projection providers from GPU declarations
body: The generated ExposureTonemapSystem binding is named sceneRadianceHistoryOutput_current from the StateFrameTargetsRef current projection, while the graph exposed only sceneRadianceHistoryOutput. I added a second hand-written Provide call to bind the same CURRENT_HISTORY_IMAGE_VIEW under the generated name. Derive current/history provider aliases from the declaration or emit graph provider intents so consumers do not duplicate this mapping.

title: Keep build waiters queued through same-lane fairness turns
body: The native post-alias all-check request exited 143 before the CMake payload with '[box:turn] rjs2 yielding to its queued rjs2-post-alias-editor-producer (fair interleaving)'. The build request was dropped while a same-agent GPU check was ahead, so the lane must re-submit it after that check. Preserve the blocked build waiter or return a continuation handle across fairness yields.

title: Make shared queue waitlists interoperable across wrapper versions
body: The global-queue job rjs2-post-alias-editor-producer-retry1 repeatedly logged 'ignoring queued pid=56936 as a head: it was enqueued by a different wrapper version (wrapper=f22aba84244ff5ba), this one is 3a4d601e7db23d09'. Jobs from two live wrapper versions share the queue, but the waiting admission loop ignores the foreign-version head. Use a versioned shared protocol or normalize entries so fairness and progress continue across wrapper upgrades.

title: Clear stale VIXEN kernel override when returning to tracked pin
body: Existing CMake build trees retain VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE after the source switches back to the tracked kernel pin. To use dc6c87b7, both existing WSL and native trees needed an explicit -DVIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE= configure argument. Make the pin transition clear a stale override or expose a documented tracked-pin reset action so the configure banner and actual snapshot cannot silently remain on an old per-tree pin.

title: Derive SSBO block provider aliases from generated binding names
body: The generated tone-map system emits storage block names meterBlock and LightingConfigSSBOBlock while BuildRenderGraph exposes the corresponding nodes under meter and LightingConfigSSBO, so I had to add exact-name Provide aliases to the same exposureMeterBuffer and lightingConfigNode objects. Derive graph provider intent from the generated binding declarations or declare the mapping once in schema so source and emitted bindings cannot drift.

title: Partition GPU split tests into parallel queued shards
body: A single CTest invocation with -j6 stayed serialized on tests guarded by RESOURCE_LOCK vixen_gpu_device and the all-GPU split was too slow. I manually built six disjoint --tests-from-file lists from the 172 selected names and launched each through a separate shared GPU queue job. Have the split runner shard and aggregate the exact selected inventory automatically while preserving fixture dependencies.

title: Resolve the Windows command path for queued WSL jobs
body: A queued native CMake preflight from the WSL shell using cmd.exe /c where cmake failed with exit 127 because cmd.exe is not on the Linux PATH, even though Windows interop is enabled. I had to use the absolute /mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe path for the native build and CTest commands. Let the queue or native build launcher resolve the configured Windows command path automatically.

title: Budget GPU fixture timeouts for concurrent shared jobs
body: In the full split, the queued ctest --tests-from-file tests-3.txt run timed out in vixen_hud_capture_producer at its fixed 180.36-second limit while four shared GPU shards were active; the same test passed in another shard at 148.84s and again at 69.87s and 32.37s after the split drained. I reran the producer plus its two skipped fixture dependents in a separate queued job and all passed. Give capture fixtures load-aware timeouts or enough headroom for the shared queue.

title: Make shared GPU reservation cleanup race-safe
body: During the parallel native parity captures, with-test-lock.sh line 1039 reported a missing /tmp/undertow-box-memory-reservation.<pid> file while shared GPU jobs were active. The wrapper recovered and captures passed without manual retry. Guard concurrent reservation creation and cleanup so admission cannot observe a live reservation disappear.
